      protected <T extends PorticoMessage>
      T      		 LRCMessageHandler.fill(T instance)
      This will initialize the various parts of the given instance of the a PorticoMessage subclass and return it (so you can chain this call if you want).
      protected <T extends PorticoMessage>
      T      		 LRCMessageHandler.fill(T instance, int target)

      Methods in org.portico.lrc that return PorticoMessage 
      Modifier and Type Method and Description
      PorticoMessage LRCMessageQueue.peekTSO()
      This method will return the callback message at the head of the TSO queue, but it WILL NOT REMOVE IT.
      PorticoMessage LRCMessageQueue.poll()
      Fetch the next available message from the queue.
      PorticoMessage LRCMessageQueue.poll(long timeoutNanos)
      This method is the same as LRCMessageQueue.poll() except that if there are no messages available, it will block until there are (or until the timeout value has been reached).
      PorticoMessage LRCMessageQueue.pollUntil(Date deadline)
      This method is the same as LRCMessageQueue.poll() except that if there are no messages available, it will block until there are (or until the deadline time has been reached).
      PorticoMessage LRCMessageQueue.pollUntilNextMessage()
      This method is the same as LRCMessageQueue.poll(long) except that it will wait without timing out until a new message is available.

      This method will take the given message and process it in the incoming message sink.

      This method will take the given message and process it in the *outgoing* message sink.
      protected void LRCMessageHandler.vetoIfMessageFromUs(PorticoMessage request)
      This method will check the source ID of the message and if it is the same as our federate handle, it will throw a VetoException, ending processing.
      protected void LRCMessageHandler.vetoUnlessForUs(PorticoMessage request)
      This method will check the incoming request to see if the target federate handle is the same as the handle of the local federate (accessed through the LRCState).
      protected void LRCMessageHandler.vetoUnlessForUsOrBroadcast(PorticoMessage request)
      This method will check the PorticoMessage to see if the kernel is an intended target of the message.
      protected void LRCMessageHandler.vetoUnlessFromUs(PorticoMessage request)
      This method will check the source ID of the message and if it ISN'T the same as out federate handle it will throw a VetoException, ending processing.
